**Possibly, but it is not yet confirmed.** Satellite data mapped approximately 13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property in 2025, about 3.9% of its area. Of that, 13.1 hectares overlap land mapped as native forest in 2021.

The finding is pending corroboration because 2025 is the latest observed year; a later observation is needed to assess whether the change persists. The evidence does not establish the cause or whether permanent deforestation or land-use change occurred.
